note: CD4pos: helper T cells — distinct horizontal band at high CD4 (CD4+); the CD4-low / CD4-mid cluster (CD8 T cells, DNT, etc.) below is excluded. CD3 (x) is a parent-purity sanity-check axis (parent already CD3+, all events at CD3-high).
tips: Positive selection of helper T cells within CD3+ T cells. CD4pos: CD4+. Axis design caveat: x_marker is CD3, but parent is already CD3+ — CD3 on x is a purity sanity-check axis (events should cluster at CD3-high); the actual call is driven by CD4 on y. CD8+ and DNT/DPT cells are not annotated because this panel's downstream goal is Treg identification, which is CD4-restricted.
